import PrisonersDilemma.Program
import PrisonersDilemma.Dynamics
import PrisonersDilemma.BaseTheorems
import PrisonersDilemma.Base.Asymptotics
import PrisonersDilemma.Base.Helpers

import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.LlmGenerations.CIMCIC
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.OBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.CooperateBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Bots.DefectBot
import PrisonersDilemma.Theorems.CooperateBot.Helpers
import PrisonersDilemma.Theorems.DefectBot.Helpers

open PD
open PD.BaseTheorems
open PD.Bots
namespace PD.Theorems

abbrev cio_guard_botDefect (k : Nat) : Formula :=
  .impl (.plays (CIMCIC k) (.bot DefectBot) Action.C)
        (.plays (.bot DefectBot) (CIMCIC k) Action.C)

theorem cio_botDefect_consequent_not_provable (k m : Nat) :
    ¬ Pf m (.plays (.bot DefectBot) (CIMCIC k) Action.C) := by
  intro h
  exact interp_bot_DefectBot_plays_C_false (CIMCIC k) (Pf_sound m _ h)

theorem cio_bot_no_provable_forbidden (k : Nat) :
    ∀ {m : Nat} {φ : Formula}, Pf m φ →
      ¬ TailTo (.plays (.bot DefectBot) (CIMCIC k) Action.C) φ :=
  no_provable_tailTo_unreadable _ _ _
    (fun n hA => cio_botDefect_consequent_not_provable k n (.atom hA))
    (by rintro (⟨_, _, _, _, h⟩ | ⟨_, _, h⟩ | ⟨_, _, h⟩ | ⟨_, _, _, _, h⟩ |
          ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, h⟩ | ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, h⟩) <;> simp [DefectBot] at h)
    (by intro L h
        cases L with
        | nil => simp [searchPlug, DefectBot] at h
        | cons hd tl => obtain ⟨g, ψ, e⟩ := hd; simp [searchPlug, DefectBot] at h)
    (by intro hd L h
        cases hd with
        | searchL g' ψ' e' => simp [ctxPlug, DefectBot] at h
        | iteL z' aT' other' => simp [ctxPlug, DefectBot] at h)

theorem cio_botDefect_guard_not_provable (k m : Nat) :
    ¬ Pf m (cio_guard_botDefect k) := by
  intro h
  refine cio_bot_no_provable_forbidden k h ?_
  exact ⟨rfl, by simp [CIMCIC]⟩

theorem cio_interp_OBot_C_false (k : Nat) :
    ¬ (Formula.plays OBot (CIMCIC k) Action.C).interp := by
  sorry

/-- The forbidden set: target consequent, false DefectBot probe, and the searchBranch box. -/
def cioS (k : Nat) : Formula → Prop := fun φ =>
  φ = .plays OBot (CIMCIC k) Action.C ∨
  φ = .plays (CIMCIC k) (.bot DefectBot) Action.C ∨
  φ = .box k (cio_guard_botDefect k)

theorem cio_census (k : Nat) :
    ∀ K φ, Pf K φ → K ≤ k → TailToS (cioS k) φ → False := by
  intro K
  induction K using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ K ih =>
    intro φ hp hK htail
    cases hp with
    | atom h =>
        cases h with
        | mk hpp hn =>
          rename_i me oppo a n
          rcases htail with h1 | h1 | h1
          · injection h1 with e1 e2 e3; subst e1; subst e2; subst e3
            exact cio_interp_OBot_C_false k ⟨n, by simpa [play] using playsProof_sound hpp⟩
          · injection h1 with e1 e2 e3; subst e1; subst e2; subst e3
            cases hpp with
            | search_t hg hbr => exact cio_botDefect_guard_not_provable k _ hg
            | search_f hneg hbr => cases hbr
          · exact absurd h1 (by simp [cioS])
    | searchBranch g ψ a b me oppo hme hsz =>
        obtain ⟨htl, hant⟩ := htail
        rcases htl with h1 | h1 | h1
        · injection h1 with e1 e2 e3; rw [hme] at e1; exact absurd e1.symm (by simp [OBot])
        · injection h1 with e1 e2 e3; subst e2; subst e3
          rw [hme] at e1
          simp only [CIMCIC, Prog.search.injEq] at e1
          obtain ⟨eg, eψ, -, -⟩ := e1
          subst eg; subst eψ
          refine hant (Or.inr (Or.inr ?_))
          rw [hme]
          simp [cio_guard_botDefect, CIMCIC, Formula.subst, Prog.subst]
        · exact absurd h1 (by simp [cioS])
    | simStep me p q oppo a hme hsz =>
        obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ := htail
        rcases htl with h1 | h1 | h1
        · injection h1 with e1; rw [hme] at e1; exact absurd e1.symm (by simp [OBot])
        · injection h1 with e1; rw [hme] at e1; exact absurd e1.symm (by simp [CIMCIC])
        · exact absurd h1 (by simp [cioS])
    | botSimStep me p q oppo a hme hsz =>
        obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ := htail
        rcases htl with h1 | h1 | h1
        · injection h1 with e1; rw [hme] at e1; exact absurd e1.symm (by simp [OBot])
        · injection h1 with e1; rw [hme] at e1; exact absurd e1.symm (by simp [CIMCIC])
        · exact absurd h1 (by simp [cioS])
    | botSearchStep g ψ a b me oppo hme hsz =>
        obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ := htail
        rcases htl with h1 | h1 | h1
        · injection h1 with e1; rw [hme] at e1; exact absurd e1.symm (by simp [OBot])
        · injection h1 with e1; rw [hme] at e1; exact absurd e1.symm (by simp [CIMCIC])
        · exact absurd h1 (by simp [cioS])
    | iteBranchSearch_t g z a' c0 c1 ψ q me oppo hme hsz =>
        obtain ⟨⟨htl, -⟩, -⟩ := htail
        rcases htl with h1 | h1 | h1
        · injection h1 with e1; rw [hme] at e1; exact absurd e1.symm (by simp [OBot])
        · injection h1 with e1; rw [hme] at e1; exact absurd e1.symm (by simp [CIMCIC])
        · exact absurd h1 (by simp [cioS])
    | searchThenSearch_t k₁ k₂ m ψ₁ ψ₂ c0 c1 q me oppo hme hpre hm hsz =>
        obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ := htail
        rcases htl with h1 | h1 | h1
        · injection h1 with e1; rw [hme] at e1; exact absurd e1.symm (by simp [OBot])
        · injection h1 with e1; rw [hme] at e1; exact absurd e1.symm (by simp [CIMCIC])
        · exact absurd h1 (by simp [cioS])

        obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ := htail
        rw [TailToS_implChain] at htl
        obtain ⟨h1, hall⟩ := htl
        rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1
        · injection h1 with e1; rw [hme] at e1; exact absurd e1.symm (by simp [OBot])

          rw [hme] at e1
          -- me = CIMCIC = .search k guard (.const C)(.const D); searchPlug L (const C) = .const C
          simp only [CIMCIC, Prog.search.injEq] at e1
          obtain ⟨eg, eψ, epl, -⟩ := e1
          -- searchPlug L (.const C) = .const C forces L = []

              -- box is `□_{g₁}(ψ₁.subst me oppo)`; htail's OUTER structure had it as head.
              -- Actually the conclusion is `.impl (box) (implChain [] (plays me oppo C))`
              -- = `.impl (box) (plays me oppo C)`.  The head box is forbidden via hant?
              -- But we consumed htail into htl via TailToS_implChain on searchGuards L=[].
              -- The searchChain conclusion is `.impl (box g₁ (ψ₁.subst me oppo)) (implChain (searchGuards me oppo L) (plays me oppo a))`.
              -- We destructured the WHOLE thing? No—htail is TailToS of the FULL impl.
              sorry
          | cons hd tl =>
              obtain ⟨gg, ψψ, ee⟩ := hd
              simp [searchPlug] at epl
        · exact absurd h1 (by simp [cioS])
    | ctxChain hd L a me oppo hme hsz =>
        sorry
    | eqRefl p hsz => obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ | htl := htail <;> simp [cioS] at htl
    | eqNeg p q hne hsz => obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ | htl := htail <;> simp [cioS] at htl
    | atomNeg p q b aN m hcert hne hsz => simp [cioS] at htail
    | atomBoxImpl kBox p q a hcert hsz =>
        obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ := htail; simp [cioS] at htl
    | boxIntro kIn K φ' hprem hsz =>
        -- box conclusion: only forbidden if `□_kIn φ' = □_k g_Def'`
        rcases htail with h1 | h1 | h1
        · simp [cioS] at h1
        · simp [cioS] at h1
        · injection h1 with e1 e2; subst e1; subst e2
          exact cio_botDefect_guard_not_provable k _ hprem
    | axK a b c m K φ' α hprem hgate hsz =>
        obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ := htail; simp [cioS] at htl
    | axKf a b c K φ' α hgate hsz =>
        obtain ⟨⟨htl, -⟩, -⟩ := htail; simp [cioS] at htl
    | box4 a b K φ' hgate hsz =>
        obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ := htail; simp [cioS] at htl
    | boxMono a b K φ' hab hsz =>
        obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ := htail; simp [cioS] at htl
    | diagF pm fb g K tgt hgate hsz =>
        obtain ⟨⟨htl, -⟩, -⟩ := htail; simp [cioS] at htl
    | diagB pm fb g K tgt hgate hsz =>
        obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ := htail; simp [cioS] at htl
    | implRefl φ' hsz =>
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := htail; exact h2 h1
    | implK φ' ψ hsz =>
        obtain ⟨⟨h1, -⟩, h2⟩ := htail; exact h2 h1
    | implS φ' ψ χ hsz =>
        obtain ⟨⟨⟨hχ, hnφ⟩, hnφψ⟩, hnA⟩ := htail
        exact hnA ⟨⟨hχ, fun hψ => hnφψ ⟨hψ, hnφ⟩⟩, hnφ⟩
    | contrapose φ' ψ m h hsz =>
        obtain ⟨htl, -⟩ := htail; simp [cioS] at htl
    | negElim =>
        rename_i φ' ψ m₁ m₂ h1 h2 hsz
        exact absurd (Pf_sound _ _ h2) (Pf_sound _ _ h1)
    | mp m₁ m₂ φ' α h1 h2 hsz =>
        have hα := Formula.size_pos φ'
        by_cases hφt : TailToS (cioS k) φ'
        · exact ih m₂ (by omega) _ h2 (by omega) hφt
        · exact ih m₁ (by omega) _ h1 (by omega) ⟨htail, hφt⟩
    | implTrans φ' ψ χ a b h1 h2 hsz =>
        obtain ⟨hχ, hφn⟩ := htail
        simp only [Formula.size] at hsz
        by_cases hψt : TailToS (cioS k) ψ
        · exact ih a (by omega) _ h1 (by omega) ⟨hψt, hφn⟩
        · exact ih b (by omega) _ h2 (by omega) ⟨hχ, hψt⟩
    | weakenImpl φ' ψ m hψ hsz =>
        obtain ⟨hψt, -⟩ := htail
        simp only [Formula.size] at hsz
        exact ih m (by omega) ψ hψ (by omega) hψt
    | impS2 φ' ψ χ m₁ m₂ K' h1 h2 hsz =>
        obtain ⟨hχ, hφn⟩ := htail
        simp only [Formula.size] at hsz
        by_cases hψt : TailToS (cioS k) ψ
        · exact ih m₂ (by omega) _ h2 (by omega) ⟨hψt, hφn⟩
        · exact ih m₁ (by omega) _ h1 (by omega) ⟨⟨hχ, hψt⟩, hφn⟩
